G2.basis_en: Source SHA-256 was recomputed and matched.

G6.basis_zh: 未声明 ontology 或权限绑定。
G6.basis_en: No ontology or authority binding is asserted.

G7.basis_zh: FormalCoverageGap 与 invented_constraints 均为空。

G8.basis_zh: 固定模型和不确定性结论可重放。
G8.basis_en: The fixed model and underdetermination conclusion are replayable.

G9.basis_zh: 未量化选图和视觉验收被正确识别为改变边界的歧义。
G9.basis_en: Unquantified image selection and visual acceptance are correctly identified as boundary-changing ambiguity.

final_reason_en: G1–G10 pass; this case is accurately adjudicated as underdetermined and no ADMIN_GOLD_FROZEN is generated.
